findings.title: get(id) does not trim its argument, unlike find(titleOrId)
findings.why: find() trims its input before looking up a title or id, but get() compares the raw string. list.find(' task-1 ') succeeds while list.get(' task-1 ') returns not-found, so the two lookups by id behave differently.

findings.title: Very long import line
findings.why: The task.ts import now lists 10 names on one line, which is hard to read and probably over the line length used elsewhere. It would be better split over several lines.
